risks.note: Management states that because of the geo-political situation multiple industries are facing shortages in petroleum-derived products, especially natural gas which is a key input for production, exposing the Company's sourcing base to supply disruption.
The Company reports it is witnessing an impact on the rupee, and it runs foreign-currency expenditure alongside much smaller foreign-currency earnings, so a weaker rupee raises landed input cost.
Management flags pressure on prices of select raw materials, shipping and capex, which compresses gross margin and raises the cost of the store-expansion programme.
risks.risk: Raw material, shipping and capex cost inflation

risks.note: The Directors' Report states consumption has slowed down due to supply-led inflationary pressure - a direct threat to discretionary apparel volumes and to like-for-like retail growth.

Retail growth continues predominantly through the FOFO model across 475+ cities and towns, so store additions, working capital and execution quality depend on franchise partners rather than owned assets.
The business is a single-activity branded apparel and lifestyle platform serving Indian consumers through five core brands; there is no diversification away from Indian discretionary fashion demand.
risks.risk: Concentration in a single discretionary category and geography

sk.overview: India's organised retail comprises organised brick-and-mortar and e-commerce, with e-commerce the fastest-growing format. India retail was ~Rs 83 trillion in FY2025 (~21% organised) and is projected to reach Rs 123-135 trillion by FY2030. India e-commerce (including quick commerce) is ~Rs 6 trillion GMV (~US$70 billion) currently, projected to reach Rs 15-18 trillion (12-13% retail penetration) by FY2030.
